name: Grand Hyatt Amman
positioning: City hotel with a carved pink stone facade on one of Amman's seven hills in Jabal Amman, with indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and adjoining serviced residences
best_for: Travelers who want city views and easy access to the Citadel and Roman Theatre
Guests wanting club lounge access or a suite with a terrace over historic Amman
Longer stays in a serviced apartment with a full kitchen

facts.text: The hotel sits atop one of Amman's seven hills, where modern and historic Amman meet.
The hotel is on Hussein Bin Ali Street in Jabal Amman.
The Citadel and the Roman Theatre are close to the hotel.
Rooms have a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and shower.
Deluxe rooms with poolside access have an outdoor terrace.
Club rooms include access to the Grand Club Lounge on the 9th floor, with all-day refreshments, evening canapes and cocktails.
The Royal Suite with Terrace offers panoramic views of historic Amman from its terrace.
The Zara Fitness Center has floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.
The Grand Hyatt Residences in the adjacent Hyatt Tower offer one- to four-bedroom serviced apartments with full kitchens and private balconies.
32 North restaurant has glass walls looking onto a free-standing kitchen.
The Lombard serves Northern Italian cooking with a modern take on traditional recipes.

highlights.text: The hotel has a distinctive carved pink stone facade and offers 360-degree views of the city.
Blue Mosque View rooms overlook the old hills of Amman and the King Abdullah I Mosque with its blue mosaic dome.
The Grand Royal Suite with Terrace has hand-picked artworks, a deep soaking bathtub and a terrace overlooking historic Amman.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor swimming pools, with steam rooms, a sauna and a whirlpool.
The Lounge has two large open fireplaces and a conservatory with floor-to-ceiling windows.

considerations.text: Queen Alia International Airport is about a 30-minute drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the hotel's large size may feel less intimate.
